tex_content.source:
\label{ch:chow-ii-differential-harnack-estimates}

Let \((\mathcal M^n,g(t))\) be a Ricci flow.  Indices are raised using
\(g(t)\), and \(R_{ijkl}\), \(R_{ij}\), and \(R\) denote its Riemann,
Ricci, and scalar curvatures.
